text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding flagged a broken embeddings example in examples/embeddings/README.md. Two issues: wrong import and the snippet uses `api_key=` and a literal placeholder `<KEY>` plus an env var name `REDWOOD_KEY` we no longer use.

sam: Oh no. New users will paste that and blow up. Can you paste the exact lines?

maya: Sure, current snippet:

```python
from redwood_client import EmbeddingClient
client = EmbeddingClient(api_key=\"<KEY>\")
vec = client.create_embedding([\"hello\"])
```

maya: Problems: package is `redwood` now, constructor arg is `api_key_or_token`, method is `embed` not `create_embedding`, and env var we standardize on is `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

tanvi: Yikes. That explains the failed onboarding ticket. Also worth noting some examples still recommend copying keys into code instead of using os.getenv.

engineer_jordan: I can open a PR that: 1) updates the snippet to use correct import + os.getenv pattern, 2) renames methods to current API, 3) adds a one-line header warning about secrets, and 4) adds a tiny CI guard that scans examples for `api_key=` or `<KEY>` tokens and fails the PR. Low risk, quick.

sam: Love the CI guard. Make it opt-in for now? Or run it only for changes under /examples/** to avoid noise.

liam: Suggest the guard be a simple shell step in an existing workflow: grep for `api_key=|<KEY>|REDWOOD_KEY` and fail with a readable message linking to docs/quickstart. We can promote to required check later.

engineer_jordan: Proposed fixed snippet for the README:

```python
import os
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
client = EmbeddingsClient(api_key_or_token=os.getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\"))
vec = client.embed([\"hello\"]) 
```

engineer_jordan: I'll include a GH Action job (examples-sanity) that runs when files under /examples/** are changed and does two quick checks: `python -c "import redwood"` and the grep-based secrets check. Matrix: python 3.9 and 3.11.

docs: please add a short changelog bullet under docs/quickstart: "Fix: embeddings example import/method names + CI guard to prevent copy/paste secrets in samples." Tag onboarding and docs:urgent.

tanvi: Also update the sample README to use ${REDWOOD_API_KEY} in inline examples so it's obvious to new hires how to set it.

ci-bot: Note: when PR is opened, I can post a checklist comment with the smoke test results automatically so reviewers don't need to run locally.

maya: Perfect. When you open the PR, include "copy/paste guard + embeddings snippet fix" in the title and drop the PR link here so onboarding can verify.

engineer_jordan: Will do — small patch, adding docs header line, snippet changes, grep guard, and a CHANGELOG entry. Planning to fast-follow and merge after a quick review.

sam: Thanks — this will shore up a lot of small onboarding pain. :thumbsup:
